original_document.title: E-Invoice | Automated Tax-Compliant Invoicing for Egyptian Tax Authority | Telecom Egypt - TE Business - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: WE E-Invoice offers: - Flexible plans, full of features. - Invoice Management. - Invoice Digital Approval. - Cloud-Based E-Invoices. - Product Lists. - Dashboards & Analytics. - Automatic Tax Calculation. - Email & SMS Notifications. - Downloadable Reports. - Integrated automatic invoice submission to the Egyptian Tax Authority. - Create, Revise & Send Invoices. - Clients & Product Manager. - Multi Level approvals.
